## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npm run test:unit`, `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e` pass locally
- [ ] Docs updated for anything users, contributors or operators will notice
- [ ] A line added under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Screenshots at desktop and phone width for visible UI changes
- [ ] No API keys, personal photos or other private data in the change
